senses.gloss: m. (preced., Arab. libd, v. Fl. to Levy Targ. Dict. I, p. 4291) felt; thick, fulled or felted stuff made of wool, hair &c.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Batra 5:3">Tosef. Kel. B. Bath. V, 3</cite> sq. (interch. with <cite ref="L00050"><he>לָבוּד</he></cite>).—Pl. <he>לְבָדִים</he>, <he>לְבָדִין</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kilayim 9:9">Kil. IX, 9</cite> <he>ל׳ אסורים</he> felt-clothes (of mixed material) are forbidden.
